fields.description: Master switch. When off, no Cliq message is sent or logged.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Render and log every message but never call Zoho. Keep this ON until the bot token is live and outbound access to the API domain is open.
fields.label: Dry Run (do not actually send)

fields.description: Supplied by the Zoho Cliq administrator. The bot must be configured as 'Bot works for: Organization'.
fields.label: Bot

fields.description: The bot's unique name, not its display name.
fields.label: Bot Unique Name

fields.description: Data centre host, without https:// — for example cliq.zoho.in or cliq.zoho.com.
fields.label: API Domain

fields.description: Webhook token. Generate it from a service account, never a personal user, so alerts survive staff changes.
fields.label: Zapikey

fields.description: Which Employee field holds the address the person logs into Cliq with. Recipients are resolved from the document, then mapped through this field.
fields.label: Cliq Identity Field

fields.description: Total tries per message before it is marked Failed. Retries apply to timeouts and 5xx responses only.
fields.label: Max Attempts

fields.description: Write a Cliq Message Log row for successful sends as well as failures.
fields.label: Log Successful Sends

fields.description: Direct Message sends to each resolved recipient via the bot. Channel posts once into the channel below. Both does each, for the same event.
fields.label: Send To

fields.description: The channel's unique name, not its display name. Find it in the channel's settings.
fields.label: Channel Unique Name

fields.description: While set, every direct message goes to this one address no matter who it resolved to. The log keeps the intended recipient. Needed when the bot is Personal, and a useful safety net on staging. Leave blank in production.
fields.label: Test Redirect (send everything here)
